notes: National public-private scholarship scheme (German Federal Government BMBF/BMFTR + private sponsors), administered individually by each participating university. Applications are made directly to the student's own university, so no single institution or supervising professor is attached to the scheme. Official site only names the programme service centre (Stifterverband, deutschlandstipendium@stifterverband.de), not academic supervisors.

Government scholarship administered by JASSO (Japan Student Services Organization) for privately-financed international students already enrolled at a Japanese institution. Applications go through the enrolled institution's international student office; JASSO's official page names no university, professor or supervisor. No attached institution, therefore not applicable for supervisor enrichment.

Private foundation scholarship (POSCO TJ Park Foundation) with no single attached institution: applicants must be admitted to Master's/doctoral programmes at designated Korean graduate schools and be recommended by their admitting institution, which the Foundation does not list. Official pages name no supervising professors; the only contact is the Foundation itself (asiafellowship@postf.org), foundation staff rather than academic faculty.

professors.title: Professor of Particle Physics; Rector of ETH Zurich (ESOP patron)
professors.evidence_quote_or_summary: ETH Zurich Foundation page names 'Professor Günther Dissertori, ETH Rector and ESOP patron' as the patron of the Excellence Scholarship & Opportunity Programme; ETH student portal adds that 'The final decision for awarding scholarships in the Excellence Scholarship & Opportunity Programme rests with the Rector of ETH Zurich.'

notes: ESOP is a university-wide Master's excellence scholarship evaluated by the Admissions Committees of the respective Master's programmes, so no per-programme supervisors are named. The only professor officially tied to the programme on institutional pages is ETH Rector Prof. Günther Dissertori, the ESOP patron. No personal email is published on his institutional pages, so official_email is null. Programme contact is Dr. Barbara E. Hellermann, ETH Financial Aid Office (administrative staff, not a professor); telephone +41 44 632 20 23 / +41 44 632 20 88.

Official EPFL pages (master-excellence-fellowships and how-to-apply) describe a section screening followed by the Excellence Fellowships Committee, but name no committee members or professors. The published contact is the functional mailbox master.fellowship@epfl.ch (EPFL AVP-E SPE), not an individual professor. No supervising professor or named faculty is tied to this fellowship on any official EPFL page.

Central EU research funding scheme (Horizon Europe, administered by the European Research Executive Agency). Applicants apply together with a host organisation of their own choice; no institution or supervising professor is attached to the scheme itself (hosting offers are found via Euraxess), so supervisor enrichment is not applicable.

Central EU mobility programme (Erasmus+ Key Action 1, European Commission). There is no central application form; students apply through the international/Erasmus+ office of their own institution. No single institution or supervising professor is attached to the scheme, so supervisor enrichment is not applicable.
